4. It is stated that the use of explosives to open the last few meters of ice in a drill hole and their use in the water below the ice shelf during a geophysical survey will have "a considerable temporary effect" (page 27). A discussion of the effects should be included for an evaluation. No significant noise impacts on the environment are anticipated. However, personnel who must work adjacent to the noise source should be supplied personal protective equipment.
In light of our review and in accordance with EPA procedure, we have classified the project as ER (Environmental Reservations) and rated the draft statement as Category 2 (Insufficient Information). If you or your staff have any questions concerning our comments or classification, we will be happy to discuss them with you.
Sincerely yours,
Sheldon Meyers
Director
Office of Federal Activities
